script.base: Close road-favorite game, not a blowout: CHI -3 with implied totals CHI 25.2 / CAR 22.2 on a 47.5 outdoor total. CHI leads or the game stays within a score into the second half, so both teams stay in their normal run/pass mix and starters are not yanked. CHI's points come from a balanced script with the recent receiving tight end and WR2 still on the field; CAR can run Chuba Hubbard some because +3 is not a pass-funnel spread.
script.flip1: CHI jumps ahead early, runs the clock, and Rome Odunze / Luther Burden III / Colston Loveland routes and yards stall while D'Andre Swift or Kyle Monangai carries pile up late. That flip kills both receiving overs.
script.flip2: CAR hangs around or leads, both sides throw, and the 47.5 game tilts toward a pass-volume script. That flip helps Loveland and Burden overs and hurts a Hubbard rush under, which is why Hubbard was not selected.

injury_fallout: Only confirmed out is CAR LB Patrick Jones II (Back) on the pre-game nflverse report. Missing linebacker is the checklist leak for the opposing TE, RB receiving, and slot — Colston Loveland is the CHI player whose recent receiving role actually attacks that level; Cole Kmet (last4 recyds 28, 14, 16, 16 vs a 16.5 median line) is the split risk, not the mispriced one. CHI T Ozzy Trapilo Questionable (Knee): if he sits, CHI rush efficiency should fall and quick throws should rise (TE/RB catches up, deep WR yards down) — supports Loveland, mild negative for a Burden deep-yard path and for Swift rush. CHI WR Rome Odunze Questionable (Calf), not Out: if later inactive, targets funnel to Burden, Loveland, and Kmet; inactives are not in the pack, so no leg requires him to sit. CHI S Xavier Woods Questionable (Groin) would help CAR deep shots only if inactive — not a sleeper. CHI QB Tyson Bagent Questionable (Back) is the backup; no starter QB injury is listed. No CAR offensive injury is listed, so Hubbard's recent rush fade is not injury-explained here.

data_check.notes: No projection, no sims, no Pinnacle no-vig. Stand-in lines are the 2025 medians, so they cannot independently confirm an edge. Last-4 form agrees with both overs (Loveland 3/4, Burden 3/4 with one half-yard miss). model_p 0.58 and 0.56 are hand discounts of those hit rates for spike risk, Week 1, and possible team/QB change — not sim probabilities, and not above the 70% suspicion band. pre_mortem: It's Monday and both overs lost because this was Week 1 with no 2026 role proof: the 2025 logs were a different quarterback or team, Loveland's 94 and 91 and Burden's 138 were single explosives that regressed to the median lines the stand-in already posted, Odunze played a full snap count and Kmet took the intermediate targets Jones's backup actually covered, Trapilo played and CHI leaned Swift and Monangai on the ground in a 25-point grind, or unforecast outdoor wind and rain turned a 47.5 into a short-yardage slog. The counter-case is real enough that both stays leans, not strong, and neither is a bet without a no-vig price and inactives.
slip_story: One story only: competitive CHI road-favorite pass script (25.2 implied, not a blowout). Loveland recyds over and Burden recyds over win together if CHI throws at a normal rate. Do not add a game under, a Swift rush over, or a CAR from-behind stack. Two legs, no TDs, one market per player. Hubbard under was the opposite-script temptation and was left off.
